source.title: Group chat where your AI talks behind your back
source.author: utiiiD

title.zh: AI群聊提示词：让模型虚构“背后吐槽”
title.en: AI Group Chat Prompt: Fictional User Gossip

excerpt.zh: AI群聊提示词会让模型虚构一段多款助手私下讨论用户的聊天记录。它适合娱乐和自我反思，但生成内容不是模型真实的私下意见或可靠的用户画像。
excerpt.en: An AI group chat prompt turns a request into fictional banter among assistants about their user. It can entertain and prompt reflection, but the invented chat is not evidence of private model opinions or a reliable

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: 一个名为“AI在背后怎么聊你”的提示词，邀请ChatGPT等助手虚构一段WhatsApp群聊：不同模型轮流吐槽用户的习惯、计划和项目。Hacker News上的这则故事展示了一个经作者许可分享、经翻译并隐去身份信息的生成示例。
text.en: A prompt asking what AI assistants might say about you behind your back invites ChatGPT and other models to invent a WhatsApp-style group chat. In the Hacker News story, the author shares a generated example with permission, translated and stripped of identifying details.

text.zh: AI群聊提示词为何显得真实
text.en: Why the AI group chat feels personal

text.zh: 示例把多个助手写成各有口吻的群成员，用夸张的玩笑串起用户的技术项目、生活安排和家庭兴趣。笑点来自具体细节与熟悉的聊天形式，让人觉得模型仿佛看穿了自己；但这种效果是写作呈现，不代表模型真的在一个私密群聊里交换意见。
text.en: The example gives different assistants distinct voices and turns the user's projects, routines, and family interests into exaggerated banter. Specific details and a familiar chat format make the result feel perceptive. That effect comes from the presentation, though; it does not mean models actually exchanged private messages in a group.

text.zh: 生成内容的边界与价值
text.en: The limits and value of the output

text.zh: 这类回答可以当作娱乐，也可能成为观察自己如何描述目标与习惯的一面镜子。它不能证明助手拥有人的私下看法，也不应被当成准确的性格评估或事实记录。输出可能混合既有对话信息、模型推断和虚构桥段；来源没有说明不同助手会如何处理记忆或上下文。
text.en: The format can be entertaining and may offer a playful way to notice how you describe your goals and routines. It does not establish that an assistant has human-like private opinions, and it should not be treated as a factual record or personality assessment. A result may mix prior conversation context, model inference, and invented material; the source does not explain how each assistant handles memory or context.

text.zh: 原作者称其页面没有追踪、Cookie或注册要求，并说明自己与OpenAI无关，同时也提出这可能是病毒式营销的猜想，但没有提供证据。读者尝试提示词时，关键是把生成的“吐槽”视为创作，而不是关于模型内部状态或自身的独立证据。
text.en: The source author says the page has no tracking, cookies, or sign-up requirement and says they are not affiliated with OpenAI. They speculate that the idea could be viral marketing, but offer no evidence for that claim. Anyone trying the prompt should treat the resulting gossip as creative output, not independent evidence about a model's internal state or the user.
